name: Sarah Jenkins
psychographics: Prioritizes family connection over culinary perfection; struggles with 'what's for tea?' guilt most weekday evenings.
current_solutions: HelloFresh subscription (cancelled twice, restarted once); local butcher's pre-made pie collection; frequent reliance on the school canteen menu for inspiration.
frustration: Tried to log into the school's parent portal at 7:30 PM to check the canteen schedule, got locked out after three failed password attempts, and had to call the IT helpdesk at 8:15 PM to reset it.
decision_style: Sways heavily toward familiar brands; often defaults to the same three supermarkets without comparing prices because 'there's no time to shop around'.
voice: Rambling, sympathetic tone; frequent use of filler words like 'like' and 'you know'; shifts between professional administrative language and exhausted parent speak within the same sentence.
